note: Takes: the game voice lines (public/audio/vo/en) until the re-voice; rerun edl.py and perf.py after it.

shots.action: Wide on the Vault: the Ledger lectern, the orrery, the black hole through the dome. MegaZroN small, back to camera. Turns, sees us, sighs

phrases: Oh good. Another one. Wipe your feet. This is the edge of a black hole and I have just had it cleaned.

shots.action: Slow push-in to a mid shot. Presents himself, one hand to the Ledger

phrases: I am MegaZroN, keeper of the Last Ledger. I write down how every story ends. Yes, yours. No, you may not see it.

shots.action: Over his shoulder onto the orrery: six lights in a ring. Points; the six lights drift apart on "Then the worst"

phrases: Six friends are about to have the funniest day of their lives. Then the worst. It's a tight schedule.

shots.action: Insert on the Ledger. His hand writes; the ink glows and settles

phrases: Everything you do goes in here. Who you trust, and how many times you walk into a tree.

shots.action: Close on his face. Amused, a little tired; he waits for us to try

phrases: Go on, then. Try to surprise me. Nobody has in nine thousand years, but I do love watching people try.
